page.title: Live — Make your bucket list happen
page.description: Find things you want to do and keep a bucket list of your own.

hero.title: Make your bucket list *happen.*
hero.lede: Find things you want to do, from big bucket-list experiences to small side quests. Keep your own list, mark things done, and remember your week.
hero.note: Free to use. No account required to begin.

sections.title: What will you do *before you die?*
sections.lede: Borrow an idea, reject the obvious, then make a list that could only belong to you. 419 ideas and counting.

sections.title: Turn “someday” into a life *you can actually see.*

rows.title: Find
rows.body: Search the catalog for bucket-list ideas, places and small adventures.

rows.title: Keep
rows.body: Save what you want to try. Add your own, mark things done, or make a Bingo board.

rows.title: Remember
rows.body: Log a habit when you do it. Write one private journal entry about the week before.

sections.title: Turn a season into *a game you can win.*
sections.lede: Pick sixteen things from the catalog or your own list, then mark them off as the weeks go by. No streaks, no points: just a card that fills up with things you actually did.

sections.title: Time is the only thing *you can't save.*
sections.lede: The life-in-weeks view puts your time in perspective. No streaks, no scores: just the weeks you've lived and the ones still to come.

sections.title: Questions, *answered.*
sections.lede: Start free without an account. Keep control of what is public.

items.a: Live helps you find things to do and keep a bucket list of your own. Browse ideas and side quests, mark them done, check in on habits, and keep one private weekly journal entry.
Yes. Live is free to use and there is no paid plan or checkout. You can begin without an account.
No. Signed-out work stays on this device. Sign in with Google when you want records across devices or choose to publish.
Not by default. Publication is opt-in per item. Private work stays private unless you explicitly choose otherwise.
Once a week, about the week before. Habit check-ins are separate: log them when you do them, without a streak or score.

closing.title:
You don't need a life plan.
*You need one thing worth trying next.*

footer.summary: Find what deserves your time. A free bucket list, side quests, habits and one weekly journal entry, private by default.
